name: 反派千金上位计
overview: A dying woman awakens inside a novel as the mistreated “fake daughter” Bai Qian, tasked with stealing the heroine’s fate. Cast out by the family that raised her, she seeks refuge with her powerful, villain-coded uncle Bai Xize, where unexpected feelings grow. Together, they challenge the true daughter Gu Shengsheng as Bai Qian fights for survival and control of her own destiny.
